FX-EXA-001.says: Red, green, blue and alpha named, Reflect.R, .G, .B, .A, UnMult left out (off), the points as added: the stored colour taken as straight and laid over its alpha, so the soft columns are darkened twice; clear where the alpha is 0 or below.

FX-EXA-002.says: The same, UnMult on: the render back as it was written, its colour divided by its alpha and multiplied again; the column whose alpha is past 1 is held at 1.

FX-EXA-003.says: UnMult on, Black 0.2, White 0.8: the straight colour stretched, then laid over the alpha.

FX-EXA-004.says: UnMult on, Invert on: the straight colour turned over, the alpha kept.

FX-EXA-005.says: UnMult on, Black 0.25, White 0.5, Clamp off: values past 1 kept, times the alpha.

FX-EXA-006.says: UnMult off, Black 0.25, White 0.5, Clamp off.

FX-EXA-007.says: UnMult on, Black and White both 0.5: a cut on the straight colour.

FX-EXA-008.says: The alpha from another channel, Mask.Y (0 at the top to 1 at the bottom), UnMult on: the colour fades in down the picture, the top row clear.

FX-EXA-009.says: One channel three times and an alpha, Reflect.G x3, Reflect.A, UnMult on: a grey over the alpha.

FX-EXA-010.says: Three names, UnMult on: no alpha, so the picture is opaque and UnMult changes nothing (D-349's picture, as FX-EXA-011).

FX-EXA-011.says: Three names, UnMult off: D-349's opaque picture.

FX-EXA-012.says: One name, UnMult on: opaque, as UnMult off.

FX-EXA-013.says: The data window only columns 2 to 6 of rows 1 to 4, UnMult on: outside it the alpha is 0, clear.

FX-EXA-014.says: Not-a-number and infinities in the alpha, UnMult on: not-a-number (0) and minus infinity clear, plus infinity held at 1; the warning every frame.

FX-EXA-015.says: The layer moved 2 right and 1 down: FX-EXA-002 moved.

FX-EXA-016.says: White Point keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 0.5 at frame 4, UnMult on: frame 0 is FX-EXA-002.

FX-EXA-017.says: An Exposure of -1 after it: the colour halved, the alpha kept, the picture being premultiplied.

FX-EXA-018.says: Four names, the alpha one the file lacks (Reflect.Alpha): nothing changes, the warning every frame.

FX-EXA-019.says: Five names: nothing changes, the warning every frame.

FX-EXA-020.says: UnMult written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-EXA-021.says: UnMult written "On" (the words are lower case). The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
